title: Normalized ordinary tensor isomorphism for shifted free modules
statement: Let k be any commutative ring and let S(n) be the actual single free rank-one complex cupSingleModule k n of [lem-sc-module-cup-homology-representability]. For any integers p and q there exists a complex isomorphism i:S(p+q) to S(p) tensor S(q). Under the singleObjXSelf identifications in the three support degrees, i.hom evaluated at 1 equals the (p,q)-summand inclusion of 1 tensor 1. Explicitly, singleObjXSelf(p+q).inv followed by i.hom.f(p+q) applied to 1 equals ιTensorObj S(p) S(q) p q (p+q) applied to singleObjXSelf(p).inv(1) tensor singleObjXSelf(q).inv(1). This is an ordinary tensor of complexes, with no derived localization or arbitrary representative maps.

source.place: Section 15.64, equation-simple-tor-product: the single free complexes and tensor-of-cocycles construction.

proof.text: Use cupSingleModule from lem-sc-module-cup-homology-representability, without using its representability theorem. The private tensor_term_zero proves that a summand with a != p or b != q is zero, using preservation of zero objects by tensoring. The private tensor_support_zero applies coproduct hom extensionality to show the total term is zero when n != p+q. The private tensor_support_iso constructs the inverse of the (p,q)-summand inclusion by mapBifunctorDesc: it is the tensor of XIsoOfEq maps on that summand and zero elsewhere. Coproduct extensionality proves the inverse identities. Compose the inverse module left unitor with the tensor of the inverse singleObjXSelf identifications and tensor_support_iso to obtain e:k isomorphic to the support term. Construct the chain map using mkHomFromSingle e.hom; its required outgoing differential is zero because its target term in degree p+q+1 is zero. At the support degree its component is an isomorphism; elsewhere it is a map between zero objects. Hom.isIso_of_components then gives the chain isomorphism. Normalize its support component with mkHomFromSingle_f and cancel the source singleObjXSelf maps. The module unitor and tensor maps send 1 to the transported 1 tensor transported 1 definitionally. The construction is valid for all integer degrees and the zero ring.

proof_origin.note: Second reading verified the concrete coproduct-support construction, mkHomFromSingle assembly and generator normalization; the sole original hole is closed using only standard axioms. No representability existence theorem is used.

theorem exists_cupShiftedUnitChainTensor (p q : ℤ) :
    ∃ i : cupSingleModule k (p + q) ≅
      cupSingleModule k p ⊗ cupSingleModule k q,
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (p + q)
          (ModuleCat.of k k)).inv ≫ i.hom.f (p + q)) (1 : k) =
        (HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj (cupSingleModule k p) (cupSingleModule k q)
          p q (p + q) rfl)
          (((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p
              (ModuleCat.of k k)).inv (1 : k)) ⊗ₜ[k]
            ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) q
              (ModuleCat.of k k)).inv (1 : k)))
